intro.text: A Striker guard at the Rose Palace who watches over Shai while she crafts the emperor's Essence Mark.

items.text: Shai forged a letter from the Bloodsealer that convinced him the Bloodsealer was collecting the guards' nails, hair and belongings in order to seize their bodies. He and Hurli roughed the Bloodsealer up.

The Bloodsealer then drank too much and was late to renew the seal on her room. Shai expected Yil and her other guards to be posted somewhere remote afterwards, perhaps the passes to the Teo Peninsula.
